headline: Anthropic shares trading on Nasdaq at $111.50, a 33% premium to IPO price
body: Anthropic shares are now trading on the Nasdaq exchange. In the early minutes of availability, shares were trading at $111.50, a 33% premium over the $83 IPO price. The IPO price was already higher than the projected range of $70 to $78 per share, and the offering will raise over $81 billion.
note: Shares were higher than the projected range, and TechCrunch says the share price continues to fluctuate.

figure.label: early trading price, against an $83 IPO price

evidence.text: Shares of Anthropic are now trading on the Nasdaq exchange, as the company successfully executes its initial public offering.
In the early minutes of availability, shares were trading at $111.50, a 33% premium over the $83 IPO price.
Set on Wednesday, the IPO price was already higher than the projected range set by the company, which anticipated a price between $70 and $78 per share.
All told, the offering will raise over $81 billion, directed to a combination of employees and the company’s own coffers.
The share price continues to fluctuate, but the opening price would put the company’s market cap over $2 trillion, making it more valuable than Meta, Tesla, or Walmart.
